component.name: tiptoi
component.summary: Download tiptoi titles and copy them to the pen
tiptoi-Titel herunterladen und auf den Stift kopieren

description.p: tiptoi is an unofficial, third-party manager for the Ravensburger tiptoi audio pen. It browses the live product catalog, downloads titles, copies them onto the pen with an on-device verification, shows which installed titles are outdated, deletes titles, and mounts and unmounts the pen safely.
